integrity: A complete standalone checker accompanies the proof; no empirical finite enumeration is presented as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only labelled simple cycles of length 3m-2 with m>=2, minimum closed-neighborhood domination, and one-step token slides; previous work covers connectivity, counts and generic transport-optimality; no independent audit or absolute historical priority established.
title: Sharp diameter and Möbius-strip metric for optimal domination slides on cycles
